params.body:
## Why

`composer audit --locked` (the "Dependencies carry no new advisory" job) fails on every pull request since 28 October 2026 18:08 UTC, when CVE-2026-45070 was published for `symfony/mime` (email header injection via non-token characters in MIME parameter names, medium). The lock file pins 8.1.7; 8.1.10 is the first fixed 8.1 release.

## What changes

`composer update symfony/mime`: only that package moves, 8.1.7 to 8.1.10. `composer audit --locked` reports no advisories afterwards. npm stays at 1 high, under the ceiling of 6.
params.title: Bump symfony/mime to 8.1.10 for CVE-2026-45070
